verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs name several official SDKs. There is an SDK for programmatic account and REST API access, backed by a live OpenAPI description. The AI SDK calls models through AI Gateway, the Workflow SDK builds durable agents and apps, and the Flags SDK handles experimentation. Each is evidenced only by brief one-line doc mentions, with no detail on languages, installation, typing or API surface. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation (languages, install, API coverage), independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as described.
